title: Check CloudWatch Logs
description: Review the CloudWatch logs for any anomalies around the time of the GuardDuty finding.
recommended_next_focus: Identify any suspicious activities or patterns.

title: Verify Activity Around DeleteAccessKey
description: Verify the recent activity around the DeleteAccessKey call by security-ops.
recommended_next_focus: Identify the attacker’s method and potential entry point.

title: Inspect Access Key Details
description: Review the access key details to understand who accessed the account and when.
recommended_next_focus: Confirm the timing and method of the attack.
